groups.label: Thanksgiving Break
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–27, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is an optional teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs Monday, April 10 through Friday, April 14, 2028. Students return Monday, April 17.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: The 2027–28 school year starts one day earlier, on August 23 instead of August 24.
Spring Break moves later, from March 22–26 in 2026–27 to April 10–14 in 2027–28.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCS start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students begin classes on Monday, August 23, 2027, on the GCS 2027–28 Traditional School Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for GCS?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the GCS 2027–28 Traditional School Calendar is Thursday, June 8, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: GCS Spring Break runs Monday, April 10 through Friday, April 14, 2028. Students return Monday, April 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is an optional teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Which GCS teacher workdays are no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: The Traditional School Calendar lists optional teacher workdays on October 11, November 5, and January 3, plus mandatory teacher workdays on October 29, January 24, March 7, and March 31. Students do not attend on these seven dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every GCS school follow the Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the GCS Traditional Calendar. Extended-year schools and some early/middle college programs use separate academic calendars, so confirm the calendar assigned to your student's school or program.
